notes.title: SPG Update 4 - 20 More Levels, and an Overhaul Back/frontend! (Linux/Mac Soon)
notes.content:
Hello again everyone! I'm happy to announce the latest update to SPG! This one is a little larger than past ones, so strap in for a little. 

Nick had a random and insatiable need to rework the messy audio script used in SPG (that thing was a complete nightmare for us), and opted to do so for this. While it was mostly fine for the game, this update has cleaned up a significant amount of backend worries, and allowed for some more fail safes to be put into place in regards to audio. 

On top of that, after some friends and I had talked about it, we found out that SPG was rather large considering what it is. We found it was due to how text was handled. Before I could compress the text in gimp or something myself, Nick, the animal, just did it anyway! Guy's a freak! Seriously though, this saved well over a hundred megabytes. Not sure what unity was doing with that text. On top of that, he also wanted to try a simple compression method on the images for the puzzles, so let me know if you happen to notice a drop in quality there. Think it's completely fine, and unnoticeable.

* 20 more star levels, bringing the total puzzle count to 100
* Proper saving client side to ensure things like audio levels and resolution are retained proper
* Better functioning audio settings
* Audio slider for sound effects
* Reworked main menu text to allow for better scaling
* Compression worked into the puzzle images [i](let me know if you can notice any loss in quality, and it'll be reverted)[/i]
* Overall game size more than halved [i](thanks to the last two)[/i]
* Fixed an error when completing a level, and going to the level select menu not allowing the music to be turned back up after being turned down for an audio chime
* Fixed an error where the first song at game launch would always be a certain one, now random

* Linux and Mac support soon, this one might take another moment, but I think it'll be good to go in a little!

Sheeesh, that was a lot. Huge huge huge thanks to Nick for doing this, all I really did was talk out issues, test everything possible, and make levels. It's really all thanks to him for this one. <3

[i]New levels can be accessed simply in the start game menu, after clicking to the fourth page of levels. Future levels will be added the same way. :)[/i]

notes.title: SPG Update 3 - Sale & 30 More Levels, The Introduction of Star Levels!
notes.content:
Hey there! We're officially around a month out from launch, huge thanks for the interest! Today I'm happy to announce "Star Levels", an initiative to add additional levels to SPG! [b]To commemorate the update, I'm also happy to share SPG's first sale![/b]

With the manner in which SPG has been developed, I can continue to support it plenty of times over for as long as is wanted. Since I'll be unable to have additional achievements added to the title, think of these "Star Levels" as a way to add bonus content without changing  those. This month, star levels. Maybe the next one I can do "heart levels", the possibilities are endless! 

Upon completing the standard levels, you used to be brought to the main menu, Now instead of that, you'll be brought to a new level select, so you can continue your journey through my puzzles! Enjoy some lovely photos from Sweden, Norway, New York, and more! That's not all though, some animals and flowers are also mixed into the batch. Hop in, and enjoy SPG!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859684/e891ffc4fd4607a2f7c8b9dddd8b71498f9529f0.jpg[/img]


[i]New levels can be accessed simply in the start game menu, after clicking to the third page of levels. Future levels will be added the same way. :)[/i]

notes.title: SPG Update 2 - Storage Adjustment/Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Another update is up, this should hopefully resolve something that's been noted a good bit. The pieces will no longer get stuck get stuck on the left side of the puzzle when spam placing. This was a slight mix-up on my part misunderstanding the severity of the issue. 

* Moved storage containing to the left a bit more to ensure the pieces wont get stuck on the side
* Fixed mix-up on the second last level continue option not working right, now leads to final puzzle
* Repaired slight minor oversight on the music turning down to play an audio queue. - Thank you Nick!

This should be great now, here's hoping this resolves any main issues!

notes.title: SPG Update - Bug Fixes & Language Adjustments/Additions
notes.content:

Language Errors:

Tomorrow I think I'll shorten the storage area to help with placement, and fix a slight error I've just now seen on a friends stream with the final level being "skipped" for some reason.
